title: Prohibition against burying or burning, in unauthorized places

versions.Latest:
97. Prohibition against burying or burning, in unauthorized places.—

—   No person 
shall in any Panchayat area bury, burn or otherwise dispose off or cause or suffer to be 
buried, burnt or otherwise dispose off any corpse in any place within hundred meters of a 
dwelling place or any source of drinking water-supply other than a place registered under 
section 94 or licensed under section 95, or provided by the Panchayat.
